name: Taichung

queries.query: 臺中市 地籍圖 地籍範圍 WKT 查詢 地號 空間查詢
queries.scope: Find city-run cadastral parcel services and public feature query methods.
queries.result: The official city map bootstrap includes a viewer key and SPQUERY pattern for G97_B_LNPAR_P. A bounded query at the WUP point, using the city viewer Referer and Origin headers with the public client key, returned service error code 002: API key invalid. No parcel identifiers or feature data were returned. Official LANDPARWKT documentation describes polygon WKT by AA48/AA49.
queries.executionMethod: Traditional Chinese search; public viewer HTML and JS inspection; bounded official SPQUERY test.

queries.query: Taichung cadastral parcel public WKT API viewer key city GIS cloud
queries.scope: Cross-check geometry endpoint and access requirements.
queries.result: Official city documentation exposes LANDPARWKT returning polygon WKT for a cadastral section and parcel number. The public viewer example key was retried with the viewer Origin and Referer headers; the service still rejected it as invalid, so no parcel ID could be passed to LANDPARWKT.
queries.executionMethod: Official English/translated service documentation and direct service request.

portals.name: Taichung GIS Cloud cadastral map layer
portals.observation: The official inventory lists the cadastral map layer. WMS endpoint is key-gated, and documented SPQUERY uses point/circle/rectangle/WKT with up to 5000 rows but the schema does not show full polygons.

requests.observation: Public city map UI; references JS API bootstrap app id TAI_108.
Public viewer JS bootstrap returns successfully and exposes a service app id/token for its own viewer (token omitted from this record). A parcel SPQUERY pattern is embedded in viewer code.

WUP coordinate transformed to EPSG:3826; request used key available from the public viewer source (key omitted here). Service replied JSON-encoded error code 002: this caller URL/IP is not permitted. No feature data returned.
Official docs for LANDPARWKT; key + section and parcel codes required; response includes WKT polygon.

Retried with Referer https://gismap.taichung.gov.tw/address/ and Origin https://gismap.taichung.gov.tw (and separately Referer only), using only the public viewer client key; both responses are JSON-encoded service error code 002: API KEY invalid. No IDs or parcel data returned; key omitted.

source.name: Taichung GIS Cloud cadastral map layer
source.serviceType: Public city viewer documents a parcel SPQUERY pattern and LANDPARWKT full-polygon API by parcel identifiers. The viewer’s embedded example key was tested with matching public Referer/Origin headers, but the API reports key invalid.
source.geometryType: POLYGON WKT supported by official LANDPARWKT service; city sample not retrieved
source.nativeIdField: AA48 cadastral section code, AA49 parcel number
source.nativeIdEvidence: Official LANDPARWKT docs require AA48 section code and AA49 parcel number. The city viewer SPQUERY retry with matching Origin/Referer failed with error code 002 (API key invalid), so no parcel identifier was obtained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official inventory lists the cadastral map layer. WMS endpoint is key-gated, and documented SPQUERY uses point/circle/rectangle/WKT with up to 5000 rows but the schema does not show full polygons.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official polygon retrieval API is documented. The WUP-point query with public viewer headers returned service error 002 (API key invalid); no Taichung geometry was retrieved.

technicalBlocker: The public viewer JavaScript supplies an example app key and parcel SPQUERY pattern; official docs promise LANDPARWKT full polygons. The example key is rejected as invalid even with matching viewer Referer/Origin, so no parcel ID can be queried.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a valid public key can be obtained through the city application process; WUP-point parcel identification and actual full geometry output from an authorized caller.
nextStep: Obtain a valid city-approved GIS Cloud API key through the documented application path, query the WUP location for AA48/AA49, then test LANDPARWKT full polygon retrieval.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: City-specific registry evidence is documented in the discovery record.
